Cloudflare | Austin, TX | Full-Time | Entry-Level

Cloudflare is looking for a Junior Frontend Engineer to join our growing team in Austin, TX. We're seeking a talented engineer who is passionate about building fast, reliable, and user-friendly web applications. In this role, you'll work on the frontend systems that power Cloudflare's dashboard and customer-facing products, serving millions of users worldwide. • Collaborate with backend engineers and product teams to implement new features and improvements, participating in design reviews and technical discussions
• Write well-tested, clean code following best practices and style guides; contribute to code reviews and provide constructive feedback to teammates
• Debug and optimize frontend performance issues, utilizing browser developer tools and profiling techniques to ensure smooth user experiences
• Participate in on-call rotation support for production issues, ensuring timely resolution of critical bugs affecting our customers
• Document technical decisions, architecture patterns, and implementation details to help your team and future engineers understand complex systems
• Contribute to improving our development tooling, testing infrastructure, and deployment processes

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent professional experience
• Solid understanding of JavaScript (ES6+) and modern web development fundamentals (HTML, CSS)
• Experience building web applications using React or similar component-based frameworks
• Familiarity with version control systems (Git) and experience working with collaborative development workflows
• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to break down complex problems into manageable components
• Excellent communication skills and genuine interest in learning from experienced engineers
• Demonstrated ability to write clean, maintainable code with attention to testing and quality

Nice to Have

• Knowledge of web performance optimization and metrics (Core Web Vitals, Lighthouse)
• Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP) or CDN concepts
• Open source contributions or a portfolio demonstrating your frontend work

Benefits

Competitive salary, comprehensive health coverage (medical, dental, vision), flexible work arrangements, professional development opportunities, generous PTO, 401(k) matching, and access to Cloudflare's learning resources. Join a team that values innovation, diversity, and making the internet faster and more secure.
